ratios.quote: Specifically, the Company’s leverage ratio must be less than or equal to 3.50 to 1.00.
In addition, the Company’s Interest Coverage Ratio (as such term is defined in the New Credit Agreement) must be at least 3.00 to 1.00 at the end of each fiscal quarter.

parsed.notes: Actual ratio values are not disclosed; the filing states only the requirements and that the Company was in compliance with all covenants at September 30, 2026. The leverage ratio is defined as total consolidated debt less unrestricted domestic cash to trailing four-quarter consolidated EBITDA, so it is classified as net leverage. The same ratio also sets pricing: the 1.00% SOFR spread and 0.15% commitment fee in effect at September 30, 2026, which are the lowest tiers, suggest a low leverage ratio. The excerpt repeats the same disclosure in the notes and in MD&A.
